notino.de: 56. The gap: form labels.

Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But 18 form controls have no label.

The lesson for every team: Give every input a visible label tied to it with for and id. Screen readers announce it, and the tap target grows.

predictz.com: 77. The gap: text contrast.

Every external link that was checked answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.

The lesson for every team: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
